name: Celebration
description: A milestone moment — your mascot celebrates a launch, a win, or a thank-you with confetti, cheers, and big energy.

clips.prompt: {mascot_description} stands center frame in a stylish space as confetti slowly begins to fall from above. The character looks up with delight and beams a huge smile. Cinematic, joyful lighting.
The mascot throws both arms up in the air in a triumphant celebratory pose as confetti rains down faster. Slow-motion feel, expressive, joyful.
The mascot does a happy little jump, lands with arms wide, and laughs at the camera. Bright background light pulses gently. Warm, festive energy.
Close-up of the mascot's expressive face — eyes shining, big smile, surrounded by floating sparkles and soft brand-colored bokeh. Cinematic milestone moment.
The mascot opens an oversized invisible champagne or party-popper as bright sparkles burst forward. Playful, joyful, slightly slow motion.
The mascot gives a heartfelt thank-you gesture — hand on chest, a small bow or wave — as confetti gently settles. Warm, grateful, cinematic outro.
